# Psalm 28 — Disagreement Log

## 28:5 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** Because they-do-not regard the-works of-YHWH and-the-work of-His-hands, He-tears-them-down and-does-not build-them-up.
- **LOGOS:** Because they do not regard the works of the LORD or the work of His hands, He will tear them down and not build them up.
- **PNEUMA:** They care nothing for what the LORD has done or for what His hands have made. So He will permanently demolish them.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 28:4 (overlap: 4%)

- **EMET:** Give to-them according-to their-deeds, and-according-to the-evil of-their-practices; according-to the-work of-their-hands give to-them; repay to-them their-recompense.
- **LOGOS:** Give to them according to their work and according to the evil of their deeds; give to them according to the work of their hands; render them their due reward.
- **PNEUMA:** Give them the punishment they deserve! Measure it out in proportion to their wickedness. Pay them back for all their evil deeds! Give them a taste of what they have done to others.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

## 28:7 (overlap: 4%)

- **LOGOS:** The LORD is my strength and my shield; in Him my heart trusts, and I am helped; my heart exults, and with my song I give thanks to Him.
- **PNEUMA:** The LORD is my strength and shield. I trust Him with all my heart. He helps me, and my heart is filled with joy. I burst out in songs of thanksgiving.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **PNEUMA:** Do not drag me away with the wicked — with those who do evil — who speak friendly words to their neighbors while planning evil in their hearts.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.
